compact_revision.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: finalizable pixel-art building sprite for a Godot tower-defense game
Input image: selected design and edit target.
Primary request: preserve this exact Plant Cultivation Center identity and composition — the rounded glass greenhouse, exactly three seedlings inside, symmetrical large leaf clusters on both sides, living-wood/root frame, top green lamp, and front lime nutrient reservoir — but redraw it on a deliberately smaller and cleaner logical pixel grid so the entire non-background silhouette is at most 60 logical pixels wide and at most 60 logical pixels tall. Simplify tiny decorative clusters where necessary instead of conventionally scaling the bitmap. Keep the same appealing proportions and recognizable details.
Composition/framing: centered, orthographic 3/4 front view; enlarge the flat margin around the subject; all subject pixels must fit comfortably inside a 64×64 logical-pixel canvas.
Style/medium: true coarse pixel art, uniform square visual pixels, hard stair-step edges, no antialiasing, no subpixel texture, no blur. Maintain the chosen version’s palette and lighting.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background, one uniform color only.
Constraints: change only logical-grid compactness and minor detail simplification; no redesign, no extra plants, no missing key parts, no text, no UI, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no reflection, no watermark, no background texture.
compact_revision.reason: The selected first concept measured about 68x68 logical pixels; the compact redraw preserves the design while bringing the subject within the 64x64 contract.

production_panel.prompt:
Use case: UI background asset edit for an existing Godot game.
Asset type: final production-panel background, pixel-art game UI frame.
Primary request: preserve the input image's exact 728:544 panel composition, bounding frame, top title-bar region, large left recessed content region, narrow right recessed recipe region, divider positions, bottom frame, and top-right square button recess. Redesign only the visual theme from industrial metal machinery into a Plant Cultivation Center theme: warm living wood and roots, dark green leaf-and-vine trim, a few small glass/nutrient-tube accents filled with luminous tender lime green, and a simple leaf/seedling emblem replacing the central gear. Keep both main inner content regions calm, dark, empty, and highly readable.
Style/medium: polished true pixel-art UI, coarse consistent pixels, hard stair-step edges, no antialiasing, no blur, no painterly texture; match a cozy botanical tower-defense game.
Palette: deep forest green, moss green, warm walnut and golden wood, muted dark interior panels, small bright spring-green highlights. The green should feel alive, not neon except inside tiny nutrient accents.
Composition constraints: exact same functional empty areas and frame geometry as the reference; full rectangular canvas; no transparency required.
Must not contain: any text, letters, numbers, item icons, inventory slots, recipe icons, progress bars, buttons drawn inside the content regions, characters, buildings, watermark, logo, extra windows, ground, scenery, or cast shadows outside the frame.
